# ciphertrust_azure_key_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve a list of Azure keys known to CipherTrust Manager. Supply a `filters` map to narrow the results. Each key version is a separate entry, so use the `version` filter with the value `-1` to return only the latest version of each key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notes
# - Each key version is a separate entry. Use the version filter with the value
#   "-1" to return only the latest version of each key.
# - The default limit is 10. Use limit = "-1" to return all matches.
# - All filter values must be strings, for example "true" rather than true.

# List keys (first 10 by default)
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "all" {}

# List all keys, latest version only
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "latest" {
  filters = {
    version = "-1"
    limit   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the keys of a vault by vault name
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "by_vault_name" {
  filters = {
    key_vault = "my-key-vault"
    version   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the keys of a vault by CipherTrust Manager vault ID, sorted by name
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "by_vault_id" {
  filters = {
    key_vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.id
    version      = "-1"
    sort         = "key_name"
  }
}

# List enabled RSA-sized keys
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "enabled_2048" {
  filters = {
    enabled  = "true"
    key_size = "2048"
    version  = "-1"
  }
}

# List keys scheduled for rotation or backup
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "rotation_enabled" {
  filters = {
    rotation_job_enabled = "true"
    version              = "-1"
  }
}

data "ciphertrust_azure_key_list" "by_backup_job" {
  filters = {
    backup_job_config_id = ciphertrust_scheduler.scheduled_backup.id
    version              = "-1"
  }
}

output "latest_key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.ciphertrust_azure_key_list.latest.keys : k.name]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) A map of key/value pairs matching CipherTrust Manager API query parameters for listing Azure keys.

> **Note:** Although some filters represent integers or booleans, all filter values must be specified as strings. For example, use `"-1"` rather than `-1`.

| filter               | type    | description |
|----------------------|---------|-------------|
| skip                 | integer | Index of the first result to return (default: 0). |
| limit                | integer | Maximum number of results to return (default: 10). Use `"-1"` to return all matches. |
| sort                 | string  | Fields to sort by. Prefix with `-` for descending order (for example, `-createdAt`). |
| id                   | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager resource ID. |
| key_vault            | string  | Filter by key vault name. |
| key_vault_id         | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager vault resource ID. |
| key_name             | string  | Filter by Azure key name. |
| cloud_name           | string  | Filter by cloud name (for example, `AzureCloud`). |
| region               | string  | Filter by region. |
| crv                  | string  | Filter by EC curve. |
| status               | string  | Filter by key status. |
| backup               | string  | Filter by backup. |
| enabled              | boolean | Filter by the enabled attribute. |
| key_size             | integer | Filter by key size. |
| job_config_id        | string  | Filter by the ID of the scheduler configuration job. |
| backup_job_config_id | string  | Filter by the ID of the key backup scheduler configuration job. |
| deleted_in_azure     | boolean | Filter by whether the key has been deleted in Azure. |
| algorithm            | string  | Filter by algorithm type. |
| kid                  | string  | Filter by Azure key identifier. |
| gone                 | boolean | Filter by gone. |
| version              | string  | Filter by version. Use `"-1"` to return only the latest version of each key. |
| rotation_job_enabled | boolean | Filter by whether a rotation job is enabled. |
| tags                 | string  | A valid JSON value. Keys whose tags contain the JSON value are returned. |
| key_material_origin  | string  | Filter by key material origin. |
| managed              | boolean | Filter by whether the key is managed by Azure vaults. |
| external_key_id      | string  | Filter by external key ID. |

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) List of Azure keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `matched` (Number) Total number of keys matching the given filters.

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_name` (String) Cloud name as returned by CipherTrust Manager.
- `created_at` (String) Time the key was created in CipherTrust Manager.
- `curve` (String) Elliptic curve name. Only set for EC and EC-HSM keys.
- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the key has been deleted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key is enabled in Azure.
- `gone` (Boolean) Whether the key no longer exists in Azure.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the key version.
- `key_material_origin` (String) Origin of the key material.
- `key_size` (Number) Key size in bits. Only set for RSA and RSA-HSM keys.
- `kid` (String) Azure key identifier of the key version.
- `kty` (String) Key type.
- `name` (String) Azure name of the key.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the key vault.
- `status` (String) Status of the key.
- `synced_at` (String) Time the key was last synchronized with Azure.
- `tenant` (String) Azure tenant ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the key was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `vault_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the key vault.
- `vault_name` (String) Name of the key vault the key belongs to.
- `version` (String) Azure version identifier of the key version.
